The Scottish Premiership delivered one of its highest-scoring weekends in modern history, with 29 goals across six matches. Charlotte Cohen, Cammy Bell and Mark Atkinson break down Hearts' extraordinary victory over Dundee, assess a damaging afternoon for Hibs at Dundee United and examine why Rangers continue to find ways to win under Derek McInnes. The discussion also covers Celtic's convincing display against St Mirren, Aberdeen's encouraging start under Mario Frick, Kilmarnock's growing defensive concerns and Ross County's remarkable attacking form in League One. 00:00 Hearts Run Riot at Dens Park 01:36 How Did Hearts Score Eight? 03:02 The Importance of a Hearts Clean Sheet 04:36 What Does This Mean for Dundee? 06:14 Dundee United Humble Hibs 08:38 Why Dundee United Keep Improving 10:07 Celtic Cruise Past St Mirren 10:21 The Latest on Kasper Høgh 12:25 St Mirren's Season Starting to Unravel? 14:02 Rangers Leave It Late Again 15:57 Can Falkirk Dream of Europe? 17:31 Aberdeen's New Era Begins 19:50 Kilmarnock's Defensive Crisis 22:27 Ross County's Relentless Promotion Charge
